grammar.q:
Debbie: Let’s eat out tonight.
Tom: OK, but I ____ cleaning the kitchen yet. Can we go later?
grammar.tip: 主詞 I + yet → haven’t finished

grammar.q: Jerry has worked in Tainan ____ 1999.
grammar.tip: since + 時間點（1999）

grammar.q: Janet ____ to Kenting before, but she will go there this weekend.
grammar.tip: 去過（經驗）用 have been to

grammar.q: Harry has kept the habit of jogging thirty minutes a day ____ ten years.
grammar.tip: for + 一段時間（ten years）

grammar.q:
Ann: Have you ever cooked fish ____?
Zoe: No, I haven’t.
grammar.tip: ever…before 問經驗；ago 用過去式

grammar.q: Beth has been an actress ____ 2000. She’s been in many movies and TV shows.
grammar.tip: since + 時間點（2000）

grammar.q: John ____ his homework yet, so he can’t go to the movies with us.
grammar.tip: yet 用於否定句，還沒做完 → hasn’t done

grammar.q:
Irene: ____ have you lived here?
David: For five years.
grammar.tip: 回答 for + 時間 → 問 How long

grammar.q: I ____ to the USA last April.
grammar.tip: last April 過去時間 → 過去式 went

grammar.q: I’ve already watched the movie, but my little brother ____.
grammar.tip: 承前句現在完成式 → hasn’t (watched)

grammar.q: William has ____ the UK. He will arrive there tomorrow morning.
grammar.tip: 人還在路上沒回來 → has gone to

grammar.q: That was two hours ____. Why didn’t you call me?
grammar.tip: 兩小時「前」→ two hours ago

grammar.q: I can’t eat anymore. I ____ three hamburgers so far.
grammar.tip: so far 到目前為止 → 現在完成式 have had

grammar.q: Alex ____ English for more than ten years. He started to learn it when he was five.
grammar.tip: for 十多年且持續到現在；Alex 單數 → has

grammar.q:
A: May I speak to Thomas?
B: I’m sorry. He’s not here. He ____ to the USA on a business trip.
grammar.tip: 人不在這裡、已去美國 → has gone to

grammar.q:
A: Have the girls finished the housework?
B: ____, they ____. They are still mopping the floor.
grammar.tip: 還在拖地 → 否定；Have 問句用 haven’t 答

grammar.q: Although Owen knows a lot about the UK, he has never ____ there before.
grammar.tip: 從沒去過（經驗）→ has never been there

grammar.q: Bill had a car accident last Sunday. He has stayed in the hospital ____ then.
grammar.tip: since then 從那時起

grammar.q:
A: ____ have you and your wife known each other?
B: For twenty years.
grammar.tip: 回答 for twenty years → How long

grammar.q: The old man has lived in this small town since ____. He never leaves or moves to other places.
grammar.tip: since 後接時間點 → 1942

grammar.q: Meg and Jenny haven’t rowed a boat ____, but they have always wanted to.
grammar.tip: 否定句「還沒」→ yet

grammar.q:
A: Have you bought the book?
B: No, but we ____ it this evening.
grammar.tip: this evening 未來 → will buy

grammar.q:
A: Have you ever ____ this type of hairdryer?
B: No, I ____.
grammar.tip: Have…p.p.? → No, I haven’t.

grammar.q: Sandy is scared ____ ghosts, so she ____ never watched any horror movies.
grammar.tip: be scared of；has never + p.p.

grammar.q: Mr. Lin has taught in this junior high school ____ seven years.
grammar.tip: for + 一段時間（seven years）

grammar.q: Federer is an excellent tennis player. He ____ 20 Grand Slams since 2003.
grammar.tip: since 2003 到現在 → has won

grammar.q:
A: Have you been to America before?
B: ____ And I’m planning to go there again.
grammar.tip: 要「再」去 → 去過 → Yes, I have.

grammar.q:
A: Have you finished your homework?
B: ____ I still have a report to do.
grammar.tip: 還有報告要做 → No, I haven’t.

grammar.q: Wesley has studied for the final exam ____ last month. He really spends a lot of time preparing for it.
grammar.tip: since + last month（時間點）

grammar.q:
A: The kids have seen a tiger before, right?
B: ____. I took them to the zoo last month.
grammar.tip: 上月帶去動物園 → 看過 Yes, they have.

grammar.q: Kim isn’t in Taipei now. She ____ to Tainan to visit her grandparents.
grammar.tip: 人不在台北、去了台南 → has gone to

grammar.q:
A: ____ you ever ____ this movie before?
B: No. But I’ll see it this weekend.
grammar.tip: ever…before 問經驗 → Have…seen

grammar.q: I ____ the meal. Please take the knife and fork away and clean up the table.
grammar.tip: 已經吃完（結果影響現在）→ have finished

grammar.q: ____ you ever heard of Chris Pratt? He is a famous actor.
grammar.tip: heard 是 p.p. → Have…heard

grammar.q:
A: Would you like a glass of juice?
B: No, thanks. I ____ three glasses of it.
grammar.tip: 已喝了三杯 → have drunk

grammar.q: The church has been there ____ the early 1910s.
grammar.tip: since + 時間點（1910 年代初）

grammar.q: Jack and I have known each other ____ twenty years. We are old friends.
grammar.tip: for + 一段時間（twenty years）

grammar.q:
A: ____ have you listened to the radio?
B: For an hour.
grammar.tip: 回答 for an hour → How long

grammar.q: Everyone ____ the classroom except Jane. She ____ still studying there.
grammar.tip: Everyone 單數 has left；正在讀 is

grammar.q: That woman has ____ cut the vegetables, but she hasn’t cooked them ____.
grammar.tip: 肯定句 already；否定句句尾 yet

grammar.q: Ray ____ the American restaurant many times, and he likes the food there.
grammar.tip: 去過很多次（經驗）→ has been to

fix.t: Ariel [[has studied]] every night [[for a week]] before her Chinese test and [[got]] a very good grade.
fix.tip: 考試已結束（got 過去式），讀書也是過去的事 → 用過去式 studied

fix.t: I [[have practiced]] swimming for several years [[before]] I went to this high school. I [[gave]] it up because of heavy schoolwork.
fix.tip: 上高中前練、後來放棄了，與現在無關 → 過去式 practiced

fix.t: The new medicine [[that]] just [[came out]] on the market [[to save]] thousands of lives.
fix.tip: that 子句只修飾主詞，句子還缺主要動詞 → has saved

fix.t: Now I often [[think of]] those days with Pip, my pet dog. When I [[read]] in my room, he [[will come and sit]] quietly beside me.
fix.tip: 回憶過去習慣（those days）→ used to come and sit

fix.t: [[I’ve wanted]] to read The Diary of a Young Girl [[for months]], [[until]] today I finally borrowed the book from the library.
fix.tip: 想讀好幾個月，今天終於借到，兩件事順接 → and

fix.t: The weather [[had been]] rainy and cloudy in the last few days. I [[hope]] the sun [[will come out]] soon.
fix.tip: 最近幾天持續到現在 → 現在完成式 has been

fix.t: B&J Café [[has been]] known [[as]] the tallest building in town. However, O&G Restaurant [[became]] the tallest building in 2010.
fix.tip: 2010 年前一直是最高、現在已不是 → 過去完成式 had been

fix.t:
Dad: [[Have you brushed]] your teeth [[yet]]?
Ann: No, but I [[have]] before I go to bed.
fix.tip: 睡前「將會」刷 → will；have 表已刷過，與 No 矛盾

fix.t: Yesterday when I [[got]] home from work, my brother [[went out]] for dinner, so he [[invited]] me to join him.
fix.tip: 我到家時哥哥「正要」出門吃飯，才能邀我 → was going out

fix.t: Tom [[was losing]] ten pounds [[over the past]] two months. He [[looks]] much thinner now.
fix.tip: 過去兩個月累積到現在的結果 → has lost

fix.t: Do you know what Lindsey’s first job [[was]]? Before [[becoming]] a movie star, she [[has mopped]] the floors at the supermarket.
fix.tip: 當明星前的第一份工作，已是過去的事 → 過去式 mopped

fix.t: [[Have you found]] a summer job yet? Mr. Firth [[has looked for]] someone to take care of his kids during the vacation. Maybe you can [[talk to]] him.
fix.tip: 他現在正在找人，你可以去談 → is looking for

fix.t: Mozart [[has written]] his first music [[when]] he [[was]] only six years old.
fix.tip: when he was six 明確過去時間 → 過去式 wrote，不用完成式

fix.t: Mr. Olson [[went]] to the doctor when he found he [[has lost]] his hair. He hoped he [[would be able to]] keep his thick hair.
fix.tip: 過去當時頭髮「正在掉」還想保住 → was losing

fix.t: [[For the past]] twenty years, my father [[worked]] in a school library. But [[he’ll leave]] the job next month.
fix.tip: 過去二十年持續到現在仍在職 → has worked

fix.t: [[Have you got]] anything for Joe [[soon]]? [[He’d be]] happy to get your gift on his birthday.
fix.tip: 現在完成式問句「已經…了嗎」放句尾 → yet

fix.t: Aunt Gina [[has lived]] in this town [[for]] more than sixty years, so she [[knew]] it very well.
fix.tip: 住了六十年，現在仍很熟悉 → 現在式 knows

fix.t: Paul [[misses]] his parents a lot. He [[didn’t see]] them since he [[came]] to work in Taiwan a year ago.
fix.tip: since + 過去時間點，主要子句用現在完成式 hasn’t seen

fix.t: I can’t tell you [[what I think]] of the movie because I [[don’t see]] it. I’ll probably [[watch]] it this Saturday.
fix.tip: 到目前為止還沒看過 → haven’t seen

fix.t:
Mom: Linda, [[you’ve been playing]] computer games all evening! [[Have you finished]] your report?
Linda: Well, [[I was doing]] most of it this afternoon, and I’ll finish it by Friday.
fix.tip: 今天下午已做完大部分，敘述完成的過去事 → I did

fix.t: I [[don’t have]] any money with me because I [[had lost]] my wallet [[this morning]].
fix.tip: 今早弄丟，單純過去事件 → 過去式 lost

fix.t: My uncle [[has worked]] [[as]] a bus driver [[since]] ten years, and he still loves his job.
fix.tip: ten years 是一段時間 → for；since 後接時間點

fix.t:
A: Where’s Kevin? I [[haven’t seen]] him all morning.
B: He [[has been to]] Kaohsiung to visit his grandma. He’ll [[come back]] tomorrow.
fix.tip: 人已去高雄還沒回來 → has gone to

fix.t: My parents [[have moved]] to Taichung three years ago, but I [[have stayed]] in Taipei [[since then]].
fix.tip: three years ago 明確過去時間 → 過去式 moved

fix.t: I [[can’t]] go out with you now [[because]] I haven’t finished my homework [[already]].
fix.tip: 否定句「還沒」用 yet；already 用於肯定句

fix.t:
A: Have you ever [[been to]] Japan?
B: Yes, I [[have]]. I [[have been]] there last summer.
fix.tip: last summer 過去時間 → 過去式 went，不可用完成式

fix.t: We [[have known]] each other since we [[have been]] in elementary school, [[so]] we are best friends.
fix.tip: since 子句表過去時間點 → 用過去式 were
